solution.approach: Verified Answer: **6.02** ($z = 6.0233 \approx 6.02$).
solution.keyConcept: Same Base Power Law: B^{p·z} = B^{q·k} ⇒ z = (q × k) / p

optionTrick.en: Ignore dummy base 140! Directly equate exponents: $0.86z = 0.74 \times 7 = 5.18 \Rightarrow z = 5.18 / 0.86 \approx 6.02$.
optionTrick.hi: डमी आधार 140 को छोड़ें! सीधे घात बराबर करें: $0.86z = 0.74 \times 7 \Rightarrow z \approx 6.02$।

title.hi: विधि 1: आधार समान कर घातों की तुलना

title.en: Method 2: Direct Ratio Exponent Formula (`4 sec`)

solution.en:

optionTrick.en: Sum = `112` (Even) ⇒ one prime is **`2`** (`even`)! Let others be $p$ & $p+36 \Rightarrow 2p = 74 \Rightarrow p = 37, p+36 = 73$. Unit digit of $2 \times 37 \times 73 \Rightarrow 2 \times 7 \times 3 = \mathbf{2}$! Among `[5678, 4516, 4826, 5402]`, **ONLY `5402` ends in `2`**!

steps.en:

2) All primes except `2` are odd, and Sum(3 odd) = odd ≠ 112. Thus one prime MUST be **$a = 2$**.
3) Remaining $b + c = 112 - 2 = 110$. Given $c = b + 36 \Rightarrow 2b + 36 = 110 \Rightarrow 2b = 74 \Rightarrow \mathbf{b = 37}$.
4) So $c = 37 + 36 = \mathbf{73}$ (both 37 and 73 are prime!).
5) Product $= 2 \times 37 \times 73 = 74 \times 73 = \mathbf{5402}$.
